title: A shape type's fields are not yet a list, so they keep the line breaks and the trailing comma their author wrote.
text: `list.rs` finds a list's delimiters from the node that writes it: a call, an array or an object ends at its closer, a parameter list is the first `(` of a signature's own code and the `)` matching it, and an enum's cases are its body's braces. A shape type is no node at all in `crates/nvs-syntax/src/walk.rs`, so the `{` that opens `{a: string}` cannot be told from the `{` that opens a block, and `rule:tooling/fmt-a-list-is-one-line-or-one-item-per-line`, `rule:tooling/fmt-trailing-commas` and `space.rs`'s one-space rule all stop short of it. What closes it is a node for a type in that walk.
